visual_action: Donald and Melania Trump are shown standing in the hangar bay of an aircraft carrier, surrounded by a large crowd of U.S. Navy personnel who are applauding. The hangar is decorated with numerous naval signal flags and a large American flag. Trump speaks briefly to the crowd. The video ends with a black and white title card for 'THE WHITE HOUSE'.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: On-screen text identifies him as 'POTUS', he is visually identifiable, and he is shown speaking to the crowd.

cast.name: Melania Trump
cast.evidence: On-screen text identifies her as 'FLOTUS', and she is visually identifiable standing next to Donald Trump.

cast.name: U.S. Navy
cast.evidence: The video is set on a U.S. Navy aircraft carrier, the USSS George H.W. Bush, and features numerous sailors in uniform.

cast.name: George H.W. Bush
cast.evidence: The on-screen text identifies the location as the 'USSS George H.W. Bush' aircraft carrier.

on_screen_text.text: POTUS & FLOTUS arrive on the USSS George H.W. Bush

spoken_summary: An unidentified person introduces the 'Commander-in-Chief,' which is met with loud applause and cheering from a crowd of service members. After the applause, Donald Trump begins speaking, saying 'it's an honor to be with you.'
audio_music: The audio consists entirely of diegetic sound: a spoken introduction, loud cheering and applause from a large crowd, and then a person speaking. There is no background music.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, fairly static shot that pans slightly to show the crowd, followed by a cut to a closing graphic.
central_claim: The President and First Lady are strong supporters of the U.S. military and are warmly received by its members.
intended_effect: To generate feelings of patriotism and to portray the President as a respected Commander-in-Chief who is supported by the military.
